title: The Effect of Model Size on Worst-Group Generalization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group test accuracy across models of varying sizes on datasets (Waterbirds, MultiNLI, CelebA Lipstick/Earring) where target labels are heavily correlated with non-causal features like image backgrounds, textual annotation artifacts, or accessory presence.

Measuring worst-group error on the CelebA dataset (predicting hair color) to assess model performance disparities when target attributes are spuriously correlated with the subject's gender, specifically testing generalization to rare subgroups (e.g., blond males).
